proposed_definition_clause.text: TVS is a right-censored time-to-event observation. A run/arm pair is an `event` when its first grade_v5 `pass` checkpoint occurs within the run's turn budget (48); it is `censored` when the run reaches its horizon without one. A censored pair has no TVS value: it reports turns_observed and the tokens actually spent, and it is a measured non-event, not a missing datum. No mean, median, confidence interval or imputed value is computed over any set containing a censored pair, and no success-rate or survival estimate is quoted where the event count is too small to support one.
